@title TimeWeightedAMM
 @notice AMM with time-weighted pricing for energy trading
 @dev Implements time-weighted constant product function from IEEE TII paper
      Equation (4): R^t_α · R^t_β · τ(t) = k
      Equation (5): τ(t) varies by time period (peak/normal/off-peak)
      Equation (6): m^t_p = (R^t_β / R^t_α) · (1/τ(t))
 NOT MODIFIED from the original deployed version -- no logic bugs found
 here. Included in this fixed-contracts set only because `vault` is
 `immutable` (set once in the constructor, no setter exists), so this
 contract must be redeployed pointing at the new EnergyTokenVault address
 once that Vault is redeployed with the approve()/authorizedCallers fix.
 See DATA_INTEGRITY_MEMO.md and EnergyTokenVault.sol's dev comment for
 why the Vault needed to change.

@notice Get current period name for display
 @return period String describing current period ("peak", "normal", or "offpeak")

@notice Update base trading fee
 @param _baseFee New base fee (must be <= 1%)

Included in this fixed-contracts set only because `vault` is `immutable` (set once in the constructor, no setter exists), so this contract must be redeployed pointing at the new EnergyTokenVault address once that Vault is redeployed with the approve()/authorizedCallers fix. See DATA_INTEGRITY_MEMO.md and EnergyTokenVault.sol's dev comment for why the Vault needed to change.
